settings.heading: Hi, I'm Theo Marlow
settings.text:
I used to buy books faster than I read them. Ten years ago I started reading twenty pages a day and keeping one page of notes for every book. I have kept both habits since.

I write Marginalia, a short letter every Sunday on what I am reading and how to make it stick. Read More, Keep More is everything I have learned, in one book.
